name: Grange Gardens Play Area
description: Cardiff Council play area at Grange Gardens, Grangetown, Cardiff, one of the 116 on the council's 2020 list. Its 2021 refurbishment added a multi-unit climbing frame with slides and rope bridges, a cone climber, a playhouse, swings, wobble boards and a leaf-themed play trail.
